seed.description: A synthetic neighborhood repair-cafe event page
seed.selection_method: Chosen as a neutral illustrative seed; all sources in this sample are fictional composites

non_goals: Do not produce an article topic
Do not treat synthetic material as factual evidence

steps.observation: The page links to a repair log that distinguishes fixed, not fixed and diagnosed outcomes.
steps.unfamiliar_detail: Diagnosed is treated as a successful outcome category.
steps.label: observation
steps.next_hop_reason: Follow the linked log to understand why diagnosis is recorded separately.

steps.observation: The log links to an intake form with a cause-identification-only option.
steps.unfamiliar_detail: A non-repair service is part of the same workflow.
steps.label: observation
steps.next_hop_reason: Inspect the intake form rather than searching for another repair method.

steps.observation: Volunteers are told to explain the cause and future options even when no repair is possible.
steps.unfamiliar_detail: Explanation itself appears to be treated as delivered value.
steps.label: inference
steps.uncertainty: The inference would require real first-hand evidence in a live run.
steps.next_hop_reason: Human intervention: avoid a familiar policy frame and seek owner accounts about diagnosis without repair.

checkpoints.route_summary: Event page to outcome log to intake category to volunteer practice.
unfamiliar_observations: Diagnosis is represented as an outcome
Cause identification can be requested without repair
warnings: All current material comes from one synthetic organization
open_routes: Outcome taxonomies from unrelated repair groups
Service design literature on uncertainty reduction
checkpoints.human_intervention: Do not turn this into a right-to-repair argument; follow why explanation itself counts.

retrospective.question_emergence: Why can diagnosis be valuable even when the object remains broken?
retrospective.joint_discovery_gain: The AI surfaced the category; the human prevented a familiar policy frame from taking over.
verification_needed: All substantive claims require real sources because this trajectory is synthetic.
